title: Keep ordinary terminal commits independent of the observation shutdown fence
outcome: Narrow observation shutdown fencing without dropping ordinary terminal/Stop commits or blocking asynchronous shutdown on observation replay.
acceptance: Ordinary terminal and Stop state commits remain truthful during shutdown while observation installs cannot mutate a retired AppState; deterministic controls cover both.
Observation shutdown joins do not block a Tokio worker on replay RPCs, or an explicit measured bounded policy is documented and tested.
